text:
```yaml
name: Link Checker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 1"

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  link-check:
    name: Check Links
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run lychee
        uses: lycheeverse/lychee-action@v2
        with:
          args: --config lychee.toml .
          fail: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
